payload.reason: The evidence provides specific results from previous studies comparing XLNet, BERT, and RoBERTa on negation detection and scope resolution tasks, indicating XLNet's superior performance.

claims.text: XLNet consistently outperforms BERT and RoBERTa on negation detection and scope resolution tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results on the BioScope Corpus and SFU Review Corpus.
On the negation scope resolution task, XLNet achieved a gain of 3.16 F1 points on the BioScope Full Papers and 0.3 F1 points on the SFU Review Corpus.
Contrary to results on benchmark GLUE tasks, XLNet outperforms RoBERTa in the context of negation detection and scope resolution.
